div.head: II Ew 5
div.ab: Gyf hwa ðis oferhebbe ⁊ his að ⁊ his wed brece, ðe heal ðeod geseald hæfð, bete swa domboc tæce.
Gif hwa ðis oferhebbe ⁊ his að ⁊ his wæd brece, ðe eal ðeod geseald hæfð, bete swa dómboc tæce.
Si quis hoc superhabeat et iuramentum suum frangat et uadium, quod omnis populus contulit, emendet sicut liber iudicialis dicit.
[Be ðon ðe ful friþiaþ.] [Ld] Gif hwa ðis oferhebbe ⁊ his að ⁊ his wæd brece, ðe eal ðeod geseald hæfð, bete swa dómboc tæce.
If anyone neglects this and breaks his oath and his pledge, [an oath and pledge] which the whole nation has given, he shall pay such compensation as the written laws declare.
Wenn einer dies übertritt und [so] seinen Eid und sein Versprechen bricht, die das ganze Volk [dem Staat] gegeben hat, so büsse er, wie das Gesetzbuch vorschreibt.
If anyone transgresses this and [so] breaks his oath and his pledge, which the whole people has given [to the state], let him pay compensation as the law-book prescribes.
